company.name: iLabService
company.shortDescription: ILabService simplifies lab operation by using IoT and AI technologies.
company.description: ILabService simplifies lab operation by using IoT and AI technologies. The company provides subscription monitoring services for lab equipment in biotechnology and pharmaceutical labs. Their software and easy-to-install sensors ensure each piece of equipment is operating according to their specifications, alerting technicians when there are problems.
